title: OpenMed session lifecycle transition
description: Shared lifecycle vocabulary (openmed.session.lifecycle.v1) for the Python runtime session, the Python streaming ASR session and the OpenMedKit speech sessions. The root validates one allowed transition record; #/$defs/state, #/$defs/terminal_state and #/$defs/reason_code are the closed vocabularies. Terminal states have no outgoing transition. tests/fixtures/parity/session_lifecycle_v1.json pins allowed sequences, rejected transitions and reason codes for every runtime.

reason_code.description: Why a transition is rejected: unknown_state for a value outside the vocabulary, session_closed (finalized or closed source), session_cancelled, session_failed, and transition_not_allowed for any other pair, including staying in the same state.
